title: Theoretical study of p-block metal–nitrogen–carbon single-atom catalysts for heterogeneous Fenton-like reaction
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00778F, Paper
Chen Zhou, Haobin Tan, Shengbo Wang, Qiang Liu, Zhenhui Xu, Peng Zhang, Chun Hu
A volcano relationship was found between the catalytic activity of H2O2 decomposition and the adsorption energies of reaction intermediates and the p-band center of p-block main-group metal/nitrogen/carbon (PM/N/C) catalysts.
